reviews.x: I honestly thought this was like the elastic cord I previously used. The cord is definitely like the one in the one photo with the n95 mask. I will save you a bunch of money. When I started making masks, I had a little elastic, used it up, and then could not find it anywhere. After two attempts of buying on ebay since all of the amazon ones said they could not deliver until June/Julyish, and not receiving, I came back to look on amazon. While waiting for this to arrive, I tried using a stained w

reviews.t: BUYER BEWARE! Not what it claims to be!
reviews.x: This is being misrepresented as 1/4 inch elastic when it's really 3/8 inch and not suitable for masks. Such a disappointment because it's really soft and shipped super fast!

reviews.t: Good, but different from what I expected
reviews.x: This wasn't what I was expecting, but it works really well for it's intended use (mask making.) I was expecting your standard quarter in flat sewing elastic, and this was not that.  I would never sew this into a waistband, for example.  It's too soft and stretchy for that purpose, but it is extremely comfortable for mask making.  I could also imagine using it for headbands, hair ties, etc.
It’s not traditional elastic. It’s more like those nylon bands you made pot holders with as a kid. Returned.
Soft elastic that is the perfect choice for face masks.
Very disappointed in the quality of elastic.

reviews.t: Good Elastic Cord For Masks, Overall It's a great deal
reviews.x: It arrived fast and the cord's elasticity and memory have been similar to common respirator or surgical masks. Cuts easy, and works well so far. The only downside was that, while wound up and tied off, it was a bit tangled to get started. A small roll would be better for this, but that falls short of outweighing the good quality. I'd buy it again.
Arrived on time. Good for sewing into masks. It is flat. Stretch is good. I ordered more.

I am a newbie to making face masks. A talent I had to acquire due to our current circumstances. This elastic is great. It's very soft and comfortable on the ears. I've worn my mask through an 8 hour shift with no discomfort. I will add more to this review to tell how it holds up to washing. I will be repurchasing. If you are in doubt and need this for face mask...stop doubting and buy it, you won't be disappointed
Was so happy to find this product available and delivered in a very timely manner. The product was even better than I expected it to be.
Great product exactly the material that I was looking for and as described.  Delivered on time.

reviews.t: It’s perfect for masks and other uses.
reviews.x: Strong and no pain or irritation around the ears. It’s perfect for mask and other uses.

From the beginning of the COVID pandemic, two of us in our home have been making face masks.  We've made over 500.  All with this elastic from this company. At the beginning elastic was very hard to come by, and I ordered from three different companies to get something fast.  This one came first.  I was a bit unhappy that it was just stuffed in the package - but it is loose and pulls out into single strands easily.  It has good stretch (we use the same length elastic for three different sizes of

I have been using this for my mask ear loops.  Works great. I put both ends through a pony bead to make the mask adjustable. I think that I have ordered this four times. Delivery is quick-1to 2 days. Since I submitted this review I have read others that are negative. Everyone is entitled to their opinion. I have made around 150 masks using this for ear loops. Not one complaint. Maybe the addition of a bead makes a difference.

reviews.t: Perfect for face mask ear loops!
reviews.x: I took a chance on this elastic because I couldn’t find any other. So glad I did! Firm cord that cuts and ties easily, and has just enough give to be comfortable, but strong enough to hold a mask firmly to your face. I couldn’t be more pleased and so’s my family who are wearing the masks I make them! Love this elastic cord!

reviews.t: Very good and soft, but a rats nest to unravel.
reviews.x: Took 1 star off because it came in a huge wad.  I was able to wind it into a cardboard “spool” myself, but what a huge pain... it was like a giant rats nest to unravel.  Otherwise, it seems to be great for making masks or any application that would benefit from a softer, gentler elastic.  I would buy it again for sure.

reviews.t: Perfect for Face Masks or Drawstrings
reviews.x: This elastic cording is incredibly soft.  Does not rub the backs of the ears when used on face masks.  It would also be great paired with wider waistband elastic to use as a drawstring in shorts or sweats.  Note:  It does not come on a spool or anything, so I used a scrap piece of cardboard and wrapped it around that.

I waited all weekend for the ELASTIC so called rope. It is not elastic. I cut 5 inches and it keeps on stretching and stretching and stretching!!! I have people waiting on masks that I am paying out of my pocket for that are waiting. I do not charge for my masks. I am ashamed to even give them away with this product.

This is a stretchy round knit cord, basically a heavier duty version of what is on most disposable medical masks. Great for making homemade fabric masks, which is what I'm using it for. I will probably use the extra for stretchy drawstrings on homemade clothes--gathered necklines and sleeves.

Does not look like regular flat 1/4" wide elastic. It is soft and a bit thick and stretches a little more than regular elastic. Works great for face masks because of it's softness and is easy to sew with.  Four stars because I do not know how long it lasts in washes.

reviews.t: Best elastic  you can buy for masks !!
reviews.x: Super soft and comphy. Has a good streach. THE ABSOLUTE BEST  elastic for masks.  Even when I was buying masks, I changed out all regular elastic  for this t shirt like elastic.  Wish it came in black though. It would also be good fot elastic in cuffs.

The elastic was not quite as stretchy as I thought it would be. However, this worked better than I thought as it held its shape. Worked great for masks - more comfortable than traditional elastic! Also worked well for camisole straps. Very soft.

The product is great. My only issue was shipping was delayed but given what is going on in the world. It is totally understandable.  Communication about shipping was excellent. I love the softness and it is working great on masks!

A bit overpriced compared to other elastics i bought, but the product is good. If i have to buy again, i am going to buy this one cause i know it's good quality and i don't want to try a different one that i know nothing about.

I have been making masks for our community since March 16, 2020.  Best elastic the kids do mind wearing their masks because it does not hurt their ears.  So happy to find this elastic on Amazon. It has been a Blessing.

claims.text: Many reviewers find it works well for making face masks, especially ear loops, with good stretch and comfort.
Several reviewers note it is soft and comfortable, with no ear irritation even over long wear.
Some reviewers say it is not traditional flat sewing elastic and differs from what they expected, making it unsuitable for uses like waistbands.
A few reviewers complain it was misrepresented, with one noting it is 3/8 inch rather than the advertised 1/4 inch.
Multiple reviewers praise fast shipping and timely delivery.
